name: MindsDB
description: MindsDB is the platform for building AI from enterprise data, enabling smarter organizations.
composeYaml:
services:
  mindsdb:
    image: 'mindsdb/mindsdb:latest'
    environment:
      - SERVICE_FQDN_API_47335=/api
      - MINDSDB_DOCKER_ENV=true
      - MINDSDB_STORAGE_DIR=/mindsdb/var
      - 'FLASK_DEBUG=${FLASK_DEBUG:-1}'
      - 'OPENAI_API_KEY=${OPENAI_API_KEY}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_HOST=${LANGFUSE_HOST}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_RELEASE=${LANGFUSE_RELEASE:-local}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_DEBUG=${LANGFUSE_DEBUG:-False}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_TIMEOUT=${LANGFUSE_TIMEOUT:-10}'
      - 'LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE=${LANGFUSE_SAMPLE_RATE:-1.0}'
      - 'MINDSDB_DB_CON=postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgresql/${POSTGRES_DB:-mindsdb-db}'
    volumes:
      - 'mindsdb-data:/mindsdb/var'
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://localhost:47334/api/util/ping'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15
  postgresql:
    image: 'postgres:16-alpine'
    volumes:
      - 'mindsdb-postgresql-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-mindsdb-db}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15

meta.about: AI layer for existing databases that allows you to effortlessly develop, train and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models using standard queries.
